name: Wonton Kenobi
vessel: Soup bowl on a side plate, porcelain spoon
prompt: a stoneware soup bowl on a cream side plate holding clear golden ginger-chicken broth with five plump chicken wontons floating, a wilted bok choy half, spring onion rings and a dusting of white pepper, a white porcelain soup spoon resting on the plate edge
build: Warm the bowl with hot water and tip it out.
Lay the bok choy half on the left of the bowl.
Slip in five poached wontons, pleats up.
Ladle clear broth to 1 cm below the rim.
side: Porcelain spoon on the side plate
note: One bowl, one person. Keep the broth clear: never boil the wontons in it.

name: Hot & Bothered
vessel: Soup bowl on a side plate, porcelain spoon
prompt: a stoneware soup bowl on a cream side plate holding glossy dark hot and sour soup with swirled egg ribbons, shredded mushroom, bamboo shoot and tofu cubes, a dusting of white pepper and spring onion greens on top, a white porcelain soup spoon on the plate
build: Warm the bowl.
Ladle soup to 1 cm below the rim, stirring once so the solids are even.
Swirl the egg ribbons to the surface.
Finish with a splash of black vinegar.
note: Chicken version: add the shredded chicken before the soup. Pepper goes on last so it stays sharp.

name: Coconut Cuddle
vessel: Soup bowl on a side plate, porcelain spoon
prompt: a stoneware soup bowl on a cream side plate holding pale creamy coconut tom kha soup with sliced mushrooms, a bruised lemongrass piece, torn lime leaf, red chilli slices and coriander leaves on top, a white porcelain spoon on the plate
build: Warm the bowl.
Place mushrooms and the protein in the centre.
Pour the hot coconut broth over them to order.
Finish with lime juice.
garnish: Red chilli slices, coriander, lime leaf
side: Lime wedge on the side plate
note: Do not let coconut milk boil hard or it splits. Pull the lemongrass piece out before serving if guests object.

name: Cabin Fever
sub: Chilli, dry: paneer, chicken or pork
prompt: dry chilli chicken: crisp golden double-fried chicken pieces tossed with green chilli rings, onion and capsicum squares and a glossy dark soy glaze, piled loosely in a low mound on the white enamel plate with olive rim from the reference image, spring onion greens on top, a small ceramic dish of sliced green chillies in vinegar beside it
build: Warm the plate.
Toss the fried protein in the wok on full flame until the sauce catches.
Heap in a low mound, off-centre, so the rim shows.
Scatter onion and capsicum over the top.
side: Green chillies in vinegar in a dipping dish
note: Pork version is braised belly, plated the same way. Sauce should cling, never pool.

name: Honey Trap
prompt: honey chilli potato: golden twice-fried potato fingers coated in a sticky glossy honey-chilli glaze with sesame seeds, red chilli flakes and spring onion rings, stacked loosely in a mound on the white enamel plate with olive rim from the reference image
build: Warm the plate.
Toss twice-fried fingers in the hot glaze for 10 seconds.
Stack criss-cross so air gets under them.
Spoon any glaze left in the wok over the top.
garnish: Toasted sesame, chilli flakes, spring onion
note: A sticky glaze goes soft in a basket, so it stays on a plate. Send within a minute of glazing.

name: Salt & Pepa
sub: Salt & pepper: mushroom, chonak or prawns
prompt: salt and pepper fried prawns: five golden crisp prawns tossed with garlic crumbs, crushed black pepper, green chilli rings and spring onion, in a black wire basket lined with kraft greaseproof paper, a small ceramic dish of pale kasundi mayo beside it
build: Line the basket with a sheet of greaseproof paper, corners up.
Fry the protein once, drain on a rack for 10 seconds.
Toss with salt, pepper and garlic crumbs in the wok.
Pile in the basket, prawns tails up (5 to a serve).
garnish: Fried garlic crumbs, green chilli rings, spring onion
side: Kasundi mayo in a dipping dish
note: Chonak goes in as fillet fingers, mushrooms as halves. Paper takes up the oil, so replace it for every order.

name: Wonton More
sub: Fried wontons with sweet chilli: veg or chicken
prompt: six crisp golden fried chicken wontons with pleated, blistered wrappers, stacked loosely in a black wire basket lined with kraft greaseproof paper, spring onion rings and sesame seeds on top, a small white ceramic dipping dish of glossy red-orange sweet chilli sauce beside the basket
build: Line the basket with a sheet of greaseproof paper, corners up.
Fry six wontons at 170 °C for about 3 minutes until blistered and golden.
Drain on a rack for 10 seconds.
Stack in the basket and scatter spring onion and sesame.
side: Sweet chilli dip in a dipping dish
note: Chicken wontons go in the non-veg oil, veg wontons in the veg oil. Keep the sweet chilli dip warm at room temperature, never hot, so it stays sticky.

name: Crystal Clear
vessel: 6" bamboo steamer on a side plate
prompt: a small bamboo steamer basket with lid off holding four translucent wheat-starch vegetable dumplings, carrots and green edamame visible through the skin, on a perforated parchment liner, set on a cream side plate, a small ceramic dish of soy-chilli dip beside it, soft steam
build: Wet the liner and lay it in the basket.
Place four dumplings with 1 cm between them.
Steam 6 minutes, lid on.
Carry out lidded, set the basket on a side plate.
garnish: None: the colour shows through the skin
note: Lid comes off at the table. Skins tear if they touch, so keep the gaps.

name: Fire Starters
vessel: Soup bowl on a side plate
prompt: a stoneware soup bowl on a cream side plate holding five silky poached chicken wontons sitting in a pool of deep red chilli oil with black vinegar, sesame seeds and spring onion rings on top, steam rising
build: Warm the bowl, spoon in 2 tbsp chilli oil and vinegar.
Slide in five poached wontons.
Spoon a little more oil over the top.
Finish with sesame and spring onion.
garnish: Toasted sesame, spring onion, a thread of black vinegar
side: Black vinegar in a dipping dish
note: The same wontons as Wonton Kenobi, so poach one batch for both. Oil goes in the bowl first so the skins do not stick.

name: Siu Mai Goodness
vessel: 6" bamboo steamer on a side plate
prompt: a small bamboo steamer basket with lid off holding four open-topped siu mai dumplings with orange chouriço flecks and a dot of red chilli oil on top, on a parchment liner, set on a cream side plate, steam rising
build: Wet the liner and lay it in the basket.
Place four siu mai, open tops up.
Steam 8 minutes.
Dot a little chilli oil on each top.
side: Chilli oil in a dipping dish
note: The chouriço will stain the wrapper orange; that is the look.

name: Prawn to Be Wild
vessel: 6" bamboo steamer on a side plate
prompt: a small bamboo steamer basket with lid off holding four plump pleated translucent pink prawn and green chive dumplings on a parchment liner, set on a cream side plate, a small ceramic dish of chilli-soy dip beside it
build: Wet the liner and lay it in the basket.
Place four dumplings, pleats facing up.
Steam 6 minutes until the skin turns clear.
Serve with the chilli-soy on the side.
garnish: None: pink prawn and green chive show through
note: Overcooked prawn goes rubbery fast, so time the steam exactly.

name: Bao Down
prompt: two steamed white bao buns folded around seared slices of glossy braised pork belly with hoisin, cucumber ribbons, peanut crumb and coriander, side by side on a long rectangular matte charcoal stoneware plate
build: Steam the buns 4 minutes and open them.
Smear hoisin inside each.
Lay 2 slices of seared belly and 3 cucumber ribbons in each.
Set the two buns side by side, tilted slightly to the same side.
side: Extra hoisin in a dipping dish
note: Sear the belly to order so the edges are crisp. Buns go on the plate seam-side up.

name: Fever Pitch
prompt: two steamed white bao buns stuffed with crisp glossy chilli chicken pieces, pickled red onion and a drizzle of chilli mayo, side by side on a long rectangular matte charcoal stoneware plate
build: Steam the buns 4 minutes and open them.
Fill each with Cabin Fever chicken.
Top with pickled onion.
Zig-zag the chilli mayo.
note: Uses the Cabin Fever chicken straight from the wok, so fill to order.

name: Seoul Mate
prompt: two steamed white bao buns filled with charred glossy red gochujang-glazed paneer cubes, cucumber slices and sesame seeds, side by side on a long rectangular matte charcoal stoneware plate
build: Steam the buns 4 minutes and open them.
Sear the paneer hard, then glaze it.
Fill each bun with paneer and cucumber.
Sprinkle sesame.
note: Glaze the paneer in the pan, not in the bun, so the bun stays white.

name: K-Pop Wings
prompt: six glossy sticky-spicy Korean fried chicken wings with a glass-crisp crust, sesame seeds and spring onion, in a black wire basket lined with kraft greaseproof paper, a small empty white enamel bowl for bones beside it
build: Line the basket with greaseproof paper.
Fry twice, then brush the wings with sauce.
Pile six wings, tips up.
Place the empty bone bowl and a wet wipe beside it.
side: Bone bowl and a wet wipe
note: Sauce brushed on, not tossed: keeps the crust glass-crisp. Soy-garlic or gochujang on request.

name: Fry Hard
prompt: crisp fries loaded with melted blistered cheese, chopped house kimchi, a zig-zag of gochujang mayo and spring onion rings, in a black wire basket lined with kraft greaseproof paper
build: Line the basket with greaseproof paper.
Fill with hot fries.
Top with cheese and torch it until it blisters.
Spoon the kimchi over the top and zig-zag the mayo.
note: Torch right before service. The basket is paper-lined, so keep the flame low and away from the paper.

name: Slap Happy
prompt: a Thai raw green papaya salad in a wide shallow stoneware bowl: shredded green papaya, long beans, halved cherry tomatoes, crushed roasted peanuts, a lime wedge and red chilli slices, glossy with dressing
build: Pound the dressing and beans in the mortar.
Add the papaya and bruise lightly.
Pile high in the bowl, tomatoes on top.
Finish with peanuts.
garnish: Crushed peanuts, lime wedge, chilli slices
note: Pound to order so it stays crunchy. Serve within 2 minutes.

name: Smash Hit
prompt: Chinese smashed cucumber salad: rough smashed chunks of cucumber glistening with dressing, sliced garlic, a spoon of red chilli oil, toasted sesame seeds and coriander leaves, in a shallow charcoal stoneware bowl
build: Smash the cucumber with the flat of the knife and tear into chunks.
Salt for 5 minutes and pour off the water.
Toss with garlic, black vinegar and chilli oil.
Heap in a small bowl, sesame and coriander on top.
side: Chopsticks; extra chilli oil from the caddy
note: Salted cucumber is drained so the dressing clings. Make it to order: it turns watery after 10 minutes.

name: Noodle Around
sub: Hakka noodles: veg, chicken or mixed
prompt: Hakka noodles tossed dry on high heat with chicken, prawn, egg strips, shredded cabbage, carrot and spring onion, heaped in a wide shallow sand-glazed stoneware bowl with spring onion greens on top, a pair of stainless noodle tongs beside it
build: Warm the bowl.
Lift the noodles from the wok with tongs and swirl into a nest.
Rest the protein on top.
Add the chilli vinegar on the side.
note: Mixed version adds egg, chicken and prawn. Noodles should be dry, not sauced.

name: Rice Rice Baby
sub: Fried rice: burnt garlic veg, chicken or mixed
prompt: burnt garlic vegetable fried rice with every grain separate, flecks of carrot and beans, golden fried garlic chips and spring onion on top, mounded on an oval cream speckled stoneware platter with a stainless serving spoon
build: Warm the platter.
Pack the rice into a ladle and tip it out as a dome.
Scatter garlic chips over the dome.
Lay the serving spoon alongside.
note: Day-old rice only. Garlic chips go on at the end so they stay crisp.

name: Holy Basil, Batman!
prompt: Thai basil minced chicken stir-fry with holy basil leaves and red bird's-eye chillies beside a mound of jasmine rice on a large deep white enamel plate, a crisp-edged fried egg with a runny yolk on top
build: Warm the plate.
Mound the rice on one side.
Spoon the chicken beside it, basil leaves on top.
Lay the fried egg over the chicken.
garnish: Fresh holy basil, red chilli slices
side: Bird's-eye chillies in fish sauce, in a dipping dish
note: Fry the egg last and send it with the yolk runny.

name: Plain Jane
prompt: a smooth domed mound of steamed jasmine rice in a small olive-glazed stoneware rice bowl, steam rising
build: Warm the bowl.
Press the rice into the bowl with a wet spoon.
Turn it out as a dome back into the bowl.
note: The same bowl guests eat from, so there is nothing extra to wash.

name: Man, Churian!
vessel: Small claypot on a rattan stand
prompt: a brown glazed clay pot with the lid off on a rattan stand, filled with dark glossy ginger-garlic-soy Manchurian gravy and crisp fried vegetable balls with spring onion greens on top, steam rising
build: Heat the claypot with the lid on.
Add the fried veg balls (or chicken) to the simmering gravy for 30 seconds.
Pour into the pot to 2 cm from the rim.
Sprinkle spring onion and carry out with the lid beside.
side: Serve with Rice Rice Baby or jasmine rice
note: Fry the balls just before you sauce them. They soften in minutes.

name: Green With Envy
sub: Thai green curry: veg, chicken or prawn
vessel: Small claypot on a stand, jasmine rice bowl
prompt: a brown glazed clay pot with the lid off on a rattan stand filled with pale green Thai green curry with aubergine, long beans, red chilli slices, torn lime leaf and Thai basil leaves, a small olive-glazed stoneware bowl of jasmine rice beside it
build: Heat the claypot.
Add the curry and the protein, simmer 2 minutes.
Pour into the pot, then float basil and lime leaf.
Serve with a bowl of Plain Jane beside it.
garnish: Thai basil, torn lime leaf, red chilli slice
note: Pour a thin line of coconut cream on top just before it leaves the pass.

name: Suey Generis
vessel: Wide shallow bowl + divided topping tray
prompt: Burmese khao suey: golden coconut curry with egg noodles in a wide shallow stoneware bowl, beside a round divided stoneware tray with five small compartments of crispy fried noodles, sliced shallots, fried garlic, lime wedges and red chilli flakes
build: Warm the bowl.
Put the egg noodles in, then the curry over them.
Fill the five compartments of the tray.
Place the tray beside the bowl, not on top.
garnish: Crispy noodles, shallots, fried garlic, lime, chilli flakes in the tray
note: Guests build it themselves. Crispy noodles stay in the tray until they take them, so they never go soggy.

name: Honey, I Shrunk the Noodles
prompt: darsaan dessert: crisp fried flat noodles tossed in glossy hot honey with sesame seeds, piled in a shallow dark charcoal stoneware bowl beside a scoop of vanilla ice cream, a stainless dessert spoon
build: Warm the bowl slightly.
Toss the crisp noodles in hot honey.
Pile into the bowl.
Add one scoop of ice cream at the edge and sprinkle sesame.
note: Honey must be hot when it meets the noodles. Scoop the ice cream last.

name: Sticky Situation
sub: Coconut sticky rice with ice cream
prompt: coconut sticky rice dessert: warm sticky rice in a shallow dark charcoal stoneware bowl with coconut cream poured over, palm jaggery syrup, toasted sesame and one scoop of vanilla ice cream, a stainless dessert spoon
build: Warm the bowl slightly.
Mound the sticky rice and pour over the warm salted coconut.
Drizzle palm jaggery.
Add one scoop of ice cream and sprinkle sesame.
note: Pour the coconut at the table edge so it stays glossy.

name: Scoop There It Is
vessel: Small shallow stoneware bowl, dessert spoon
prompt: two scoops of ice cream, one vanilla and one pale tender coconut, in a shallow dark charcoal stoneware bowl, warm palm jaggery syrup drizzled over them, a spoonful of toasted sesame and crushed peanut crunch on top, a stainless dessert spoon
build: Chill the bowl in the freezer.
Scoop two flavours with a warm scoop.
Add the guest's topping: warm palm jaggery, sesame-peanut crunch or chocolate sauce.
Serve with a dessert spoon.
temp: Ice cream cold, jaggery syrup warm
note: Three flavours: vanilla, tender coconut, kokum. Dip the scoop in the warm well between scoops. Never refreeze melted ice cream.

name: Steamer for two
vessel: Serving board, 8" two-tier steamer, long plate
prompt: a wooden serving board carrying a two-tier bamboo steamer with the lid lifted to show dumplings, beside a long rectangular charcoal plate with two bao buns and two small ceramic dipping dishes
build: Steam the dim sum and bao separately.
Stack the two baskets on the board.
Put the bao plate beside them.
Add two dipping dishes.
note: Carry out as one board so the table sees the whole spread. Chef picks the dim sum of the day.

name: Cabin feast for four
vessel: Lazy susan, four soup bowls on side plates
prompt: a top-down view of a table with a round wooden lazy susan carrying shared dishes: a plate of dry chilli chicken, a basket of salt and pepper prawns, a bowl of Hakka noodles and a claypot of green curry with a bowl of rice; four soup bowls on side plates around the edge
build: Serve the four soups first, each on a side plate.
Clear the soups, then bring the shared dishes together.
Place them on the lazy susan, heaviest at the edge.
Dessert follows as one darsaan with four spoons.
side: Four rice bowls and serving spoons
note: Five dishes for four people only fit if the table turns. Send all five together so nothing sits.

name: Bowl game (lunch)
sub: Noodles or rice with Cabin Fever, or a curry with rice
prompt: a lunch plate on a large deep white enamel plate: Hakka noodles on one side and dry chilli chicken on the other, spring onion greens on top, a small ceramic dish of chilli vinegar beside it
build: Warm the plate.
Put the noodles (or rice) on one half.
Put the Cabin Fever chicken on the other half.
Spoon the chilli vinegar into the dipping dish.
note: Noon to 4 pm. One plate keeps the lunch rush fast.

name: Comrade Crisp
prompt: a 500 ml pint glass of pale golden rice lager with a two-finger white foam head and cold condensation
build: Use a chilled, clean glass.
Pour at 45 degrees, then straighten.
Leave a 2 cm head.
note: Wash glasses in a no-oil rack: grease kills the head.

name: Gose Bumps
prompt: a 330 ml straight-sided glass of hazy pink-coral kokum gose with a thin white foam, condensation on the glass
build: Chilled glass.
Pour gently to keep the haze.
Wipe the rim.
note: 330 ml shows off the pink colour.

name: Kings
prompt: a green-glass beer bottle with a plain label standing next to a pint glass half filled with pale golden pilsner and white foam, on a wooden table
build: Chill the bottle to 3 °C.
Open at the table.
Serve with a clean pint glass.
note: Garden tables get the bottle in a small ice bucket.

name: Pitcher
sub: 1.5 L of Comrade Crisp or a craft tap
prompt: a clear glass pitcher of golden lager with foam beside two 330 ml beer glasses on a wooden table
build: Pour into a chilled pitcher.
Bring two or more 330 glasses.
Top up at the table.
note: Garden tables order these: bring extra coasters.

name: Tasting paddle
prompt: a wooden beer tasting paddle holding three 150 ml taster glasses of pale lager, pink gose and amber ale
build: Fill each taster to 1 cm below the rim.
Order: lightest to darkest, left to right.
Hand over the paddle with a note of the order.
note: Same paddle as the checklist, so no new image.

name: Single malts, neat
prompt: a Glencairn-style whisky nosing glass with a 30 ml pour of amber single malt on a dark wood table, a small glass water dropper and a small glass of water beside it
build: Pour 30 ml.
Set it with the water dropper beside it.
Offer water on the side.
note: A tulip glass holds the nose.

name: Whisky on the rocks
prompt: a heavy-based rocks glass with 60 ml of amber whisky over one large clear ice cube on a dark wood table
build: Chill the glass.
Add the large cube.
Pour 60 ml over it.
note: A big cube melts slowly.

name: Suntory Toki highball
prompt: a tall highball glass of Japanese whisky highball with clear ice and sparkling soda and a curled lemon twist on a dark wood table
build: Fill the glass with ice.
Add 30 ml whisky and top with soda.
Stir once and twist a lemon peel over it.
note: Lots of ice keeps it fizzy.

name: Vodka shots
prompt: two frosted heavy-based shot glasses of clear vodka, one with a red chilli and a garlic clove visible inside, on a dark wood table
build: Keep glasses in the freezer.
Pour 30 ml.
Serve with the chilli chicken.
garnish: Chilli and garlic in the house infusion
note: Pour the infusion straight from its bottle.

name: Kokum feni sour
prompt: a stemmed coupe glass of a pink-magenta kokum sour cocktail topped with a thick white aquafaba foam and a few drops of bitters on the foam, on a dark wood table
build: Dry shake, then shake hard with ice.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe.
Dot bitters on the foam.
note: Silky foam shows best in a coupe.

name: Coconut feni highball
prompt: a tall highball glass of a clear coconut feni highball with ice, soda bubbles and a lemongrass stalk, on a dark wood table
build: Fill with ice.
Add feni and lemongrass syrup.
Top with soda and stir.
note: Our long, easy drink.

name: Lychee & lemongrass martini
prompt: a stemmed coupe glass of a pale pink lychee martini with a whole lychee on a cocktail pick resting across the rim, on a dark wood table
build: Shake with ice.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe.
Rest a lychee on a pick across the rim.
note: Double-strained so there are no ice chips.

name: Tamarind chilli margarita
sub: Agave spirit, tamarind, lime, chilli-salt rim
prompt: a rocks glass with a red chilli-salt rim holding a brown-amber tamarind margarita over one large clear ice cube with a lime wheel, on a dark wood table
build: Rim half the glass with chilli salt.
Shake and strain over a large cube.
Add a lime wheel.
note: Rim only half the glass so guests can choose.

name: Sichuan G&T
prompt: a tall highball glass of a clear gin and tonic with ice, a grapefruit slice and a few Sichuan peppercorns, on a dark wood table
build: Fill with ice.
Add gin and a slice of grapefruit.
Top with tonic and drop in the peppercorns.
note: The pepper gives a gentle tingle.

name: Kimchi Mary
sub: Vodka, tomato, kimchi brine, gochugaru rim
prompt: a tall highball glass of a red Bloody Mary cocktail with a red gochugaru rim, ice, and a skewer with a folded kimchi leaf and a cherry tomato, on a dark wood table
build: Rim the glass with gochugaru.
Roll the drink between tins to keep it smooth.
Pour over ice, add the skewer.
note: Roll, never shake: shaking makes it foamy.

name: Soju Yakult
prompt: a short rocks glass of a milky white-pink Soju Yakult cocktail over ice with a lime wheel, on a dark wood table
build: Fill the glass with ice.
Shake soju, Yakult and lime and strain.
Add a lime wheel.
note: The Seoul bar classic.

name: Somaek
prompt: a 330 ml beer glass of pale golden lager with foam beside a frosted shot glass of soju, on a dark wood table
build: Pour the lager into a chilled glass.
Fill a shot glass with soju.
Drop it in at the table.
note: The shot goes in the beer at the table.

name: Fresh lime soda
prompt: a tall highball glass of fresh lime soda with ice, a lime wedge on the rim and a bamboo straw, on a dark wood table
build: Press the lime to order.
Add sugar syrup or salt.
Top with soda over ice.
note: Pressed to order: the cabin-table standard.

name: Kokum soda
prompt: a tall highball glass of pink kokum soda with ice, a pinch of black salt on top and a bamboo straw, on a dark wood table
build: Add kokum syrup and black salt.
Top with soda over ice.
Stir once.
garnish: Pinch of black salt, bamboo straw
note: Salty-sour and pink.

name: Lemongrass-ginger iced tea
prompt: a tall highball glass of amber iced tea with ice, a lemongrass stalk and a thin ginger slice, on a dark wood table
build: Fill with ice.
Pour the chilled tea.
Add the lemongrass and ginger.
note: Brewed in house and chilled.

name: Irish coffee
prompt: a stemmed Irish coffee glass with a handle holding dark coffee capped by a thick layer of lightly whipped white cream on a dark wood table
build: Warm the glass with hot water.
Stir coffee, Jameson and brown sugar.
Float lightly whipped cream over the back of a spoon.
note: The layers need clear glass.

name: Brewed coffee
vessel: Cup and saucer, milk jug and sugar pot
prompt: a sand-glazed stoneware coffee cup and saucer of black coffee beside a small white milk jug and a lidded sugar pot on a dark wood table
build: Warm the cup.
Pour the filter coffee.
Bring milk and sugar on the side.
note: Teaspoon on the saucer.

name: Gimme Gimme Gimme
prompt: a 500 ml pint glass of hazy amber-orange craft IPA with a thick white foam head
build: Rinse the pint cold.
Pour at 45 degrees, straighten for the head.
Wipe the base.
note: Whatever is on the guest tap: ask the brewer for the pour and the abv. Rotates every couple of weeks.

name: Budweiser
prompt: a chilled lager bottle beside a pint glass of pale golden lager
build: Open at the table or pour at the bar.
note: 330 ml or 650 ml. Serve from the coldest fridge, with the pint glass on the side.

name: Single malt flight
prompt: a wooden flight board with three nosing glasses of whisky
build: Pour 20 ml of each into a nosing glass.
Set them in order, lightest to peatiest, left to right.
Add a small glass of water and the dish of chilli peanuts.
note: Hand over the tasting notes card with the board.

name: Water
prompt: a bottle of still water and a tumbler
build: Pour at the table.
note: Always offered with the first order; bring an extra tumbler for the table.

name: Soft drinks
sub: Coke, Diet Coke, Thums Up, Sprite
prompt: a tall glass of cola with ice and lime beside a bottle and a can
build: Fill the glass with ice.
Pour the soft drink down the side.
Add a lime wedge.
note: Open at the table so the fizz is part of the service.

name: Tonic or ginger ale
prompt: a tall highball of tonic over ice with lime
build: Fill with ice.
Pour tonic or ginger ale.
Add a lime wheel.
note: The same mixers we use in the cocktails, on their own.
